home.eyebrow: One platform, adapted to your reality
home.headline: Verifiable financial truth, wherever you are
home.subheadline: Forensic auditing with cryptographic chain of custody, accounting that adapts to the rules and economy of your region, and unit-price analysis for public tenders. All in one platform that grows with you.
home.statDescription: In economies where annual inflation exceeds 1,000%, financial statements lose meaning within weeks. Our accounting engine automatically restates every figure month by month, no matter how many zeros your economic reality has. It is the same logic we apply to any high-volatility region, not an isolated case.
home.pillarsTitle: Three lenses on the same truth
home.pillar1Desc: Digital evidence investigation with chain of custody verifiable by cryptographic hash. Every record, chained and impossible to alter without leaving a trace.
home.pillar2Desc: Chart of accounts adapted by sector and region, IFRS-compliant period close, and the only engine on the market with native hyperinflation adjustment (IAS 29) for high-volatility economies.
home.pillar3Desc: Unit-price analysis for government procurement processes, with official classification catalogs and a labor-cost engine.

servicios.headline: Strategic Services
servicios.subheadline: Specialized solutions in digital auditing, multi-region accounting, and financial risk intelligence.
servicios.service1Desc: Technical evaluation of digital evidence, hash-verifiable documentary traceability, and structured risk analysis.
servicios.service2Desc: Full IFRS accounting, adapted to your region's tax rules, with automatic inflation adjustment where your economy requires it.
servicios.service3Desc: Wallet and transaction investigation, and financial risk classification with cryptographically verifiable evidence.
servicios.service4Desc: Unit-price analysis and bid structuring for government procurement processes.
servicios.service5Desc: Automated regulatory validations and continuous compliance monitoring.
servicios.service6Desc: As we bring on users from new regions, we build the tax and regulatory tools that context specifically demands.

tecnologia.headline: Technology
tecnologia.subheadline: Infrastructure built on verifiability: every accounting entry is cryptographically chained, every filing is validated before submission, and every region has its own active rules without affecting the others.
tecnologia.feature1Desc: Every journal entry is chained to the previous one via SHA-256 hash. Altering a historical record breaks the chain in a mathematically detectable way.
tecnologia.feature2Desc: Automatic adjustment of all 4 financial statements (Balance Sheet, Income Statement, Equity, Cash Flow) per IAS 29, month by month, using each country's official price index.
tecnologia.feature3Desc: Analysis models for suspicious pattern detection and predictive financial risk assessment.
tecnologia.feature4Desc: Company-level data isolation at the database layer, optional two-factor authentication, and granular per-user access roles.
